clue.text: Work back-to-back on location across the way

parts.note: OP is the standard abbreviation for an opus, a musical work

indicators.note: two copies set back-to-back means the second one faces the other way, read in reverse

parts.note: the same work abbreviation supplies a second copy
a site is a location

explanation.surface: An instruction to work back-to-back on a site just over the road.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back-to-back' supplies the work abbreviation twice, the second copy facing the other way; 'across the way' is the definition, not a direction.
explanation.definitionFit: Something across the way faces you from the other side, which is the meaning of the adverb here.

clue.text: Ring road goes round a kiln

indicators.note: the ring and road letters go around the next letter, enclosing it

parts.note: a ring is round, the shape of the letter O
ST is the abbreviation for street, a road

explanation.surface: A ring road loops around a brick kiln.
explanation.definitionFit: An oast is a kiln for drying hops, a common sight in the English county of Kent.

clue.text: Top dog, say

indicators.note: say signals that the word is to be spoken, so the sound matters rather than the spelling

parts.note: a peke is a Pekingese, a small breed of dog

explanation.surface: Asking whether the top dog is the leader of the pack.
explanation.definitionFit: A peak is the summit, the top of a mountain.

clue.text: Upsets new arrangements

indicators.note: a new version of the word means its letters are put in a fresh order

explanation.surface: Changes to existing arrangements cause upset.
explanation.definitionFit: Set-ups are organisations or arrangements of how things are laid out.

clue.text: Caught fighting?

parts.note: seems to mean found in a brawl, but describes a soldier seized by the enemy during battle

explanation.definitionFit: A soldier captured during combat has been caught while fighting and held as a captive.

clue.text: Get rid of damaged spindle lacking central point

indicators.note: something damaged is knocked out of shape, so the remaining letters are rearranged
the central point of the seven-letter word spindle is its middle letter, which goes missing

explanation.surface: Discarding a spindle that has broken and lost its tip.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lacking central point' drops N, the middle of SPINDLE, leaving SPIDLE; 'damaged' rearranges those letters.
explanation.definitionFit: To dispel doubts or fears is to drive them away, a close synonym of getting rid of them.

clue.text: Being saucy, I am put outside the room

parts.note: contracted to I'M

indicators.note: the first letters are placed on either side of the room word

parts.note: taken as written
a den is a small room

explanation.surface: A cheeky child, told off and sent out of the room.
explanation.definitionFit: Saucy in the sense of cheeky and disrespectful is a synonym of impudent.

clue.text: Support it over debts, being well disposed

indicators.note: in a down clue the first pieces sit over the debts piece

parts.note: a prop is a support
taken as written
IOUs are written acknowledgments of debts

explanation.surface: Helping someone pay off their debts shows a kindly nature.
explanation.definitionFit: Propitious can mean favourably inclined or well disposed towards someone.

clue.text: Sinister operator

parts.note: suggests a shady villain, but sinister is Latin for left, so this is someone who works with the left hand

explanation.definitionFit: Sinister originally means on the left side, so a sinister operator works left-handed.

clue.text: Nazis were armed with these

parts.note: reads as weapons carried by Nazi soldiers, but means the hooked emblem whose four bent strokes are called arms

explanation.definitionFit: The Nazi party emblem is a cross whose four arms are bent at right angles.

clue.text: Racing tipster provides latest information for betters

definitions.text: Racing tipster provides latest information for betters

parts.words: Racing tipster provides latest information for betters
parts.note: sounds like a tipster passing news to punters, but means the final odds on a horse at the moment a race begins

explanation.definitionFit: The odds prevailing when a race starts are the last figures gamblers see before the off.

clue.text: Evidence of spiritual strength

definitions.meaning: evidence establishing a fact, as in a mathematical demonstration
the scale measuring alcoholic strength of spirits, as in 70 degrees

explanation.definitionFit: Proof means conclusive evidence, and also the standard used to rate the alcohol content of spirits.

clue.text: Chops and wine can make an appetising snack

indicators.note: the letters can be rearranged to make something else, signalling an anagram

explanation.surface: Lamb chops and a glass of wine make a tasty light meal.
explanation.definitionFit: A sandwich with only one slice of bread and its filling on top is a common light snack.

clue.text: Top class has intelligence and intuition

parts.note: the sixth form is the top class in a British secondary school
sense means good judgment or intelligence

explanation.surface: The top form at school is clever and perceptive.
explanation.definitionFit: A sixth sense is a supposed power of perception beyond the five senses, an intuition.

clue.text: O Valentine!

definitions.meaning: the letter O is a nought, which in tennis scoring is love
a romantic card sent on 14 February

explanation.definitionFit: A valentine is a romantic message, and O is literally a letter meaning love in tennis scoring.

clue.text: Press club

definitions.meaning: to press clothes flat with a heated appliance
a golf club with an angled metal head

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both the household appliance used for pressing clothes and a type of golf club.

clue.text: Stress follows before making a claim

indicators.note: the stress word comes after the before word, so it is placed second

parts.note: PRE is the Latin prefix meaning before
tension means stress or strain

explanation.surface: Anxiety that comes ahead of putting forward an insurance claim.
explanation.definitionFit: A pretension is an assertion of a right or title, which is a claim to something.

clue.text: Note smoker in pub is a music man

indicators.note: the note and smoker are placed inside the pub

parts.note: a bar is a pub
G is a musical note
a pipe is something one smokes

explanation.surface: A man with a pipe in the pub turns out to be a musician.
explanation.walkthrough: BAGPIPER is a player of bagpipes, the Scottish wind instrument.
explanation.definitionFit: A bagpiper is a musician who plays the bagpipes.

clue.text: An afternoon trip from France?

parts.note: suggests an outing taken from France, but a trip here is a light step in dancing, and the event is a French tea-time dance

explanation.definitionFit: A thé dansant is a French term for a tea dance held in the afternoon.

clue.text: French priest sought in Lourdes

definitions.meaning: Lourdes is a French shrine where pilgrims hope for miraculous healing

explanation.definitionFit: Curé is French for parish priest, and a healing remedy is what sick pilgrims seek at the Lourdes shrine.

clue.text: Minor shows discourtesy

explanation.definitionFit: Slight means small or minor, and as a noun a slight is a snub or act of discourtesy.

clue.text: If it works, it helps the rest

definitions.text: If it works, it helps the rest

parts.words: If it works, it helps the rest
parts.note: sounds like a remark about workers aiding colleagues, but rest means sleep, which a tablet helps

explanation.definitionFit: A medication taken at night that induces sleep, which is the rest it helps bring.

clue.text: Prepare to explode — or not to explode

definitions.meaning: to fit a bomb with a detonating device
a ... in a circuit melts to stop electrical overload, preventing burnout

explanation.definitionFit: To fuse a bomb is to ready it for detonation, while an electrical fuse breaks a circuit to prevent damage.

clue.text: They may be placed, but are best misplaced

indicators.note: letters misplaced are put in the wrong order, rearranged

explanation.surface: Wagers are put on, but the finest are lost.
explanation.definitionFit: Bets are wagers, and a bet is said to be placed with a bookmaker.

clue.text: Retired don is still in bed

definitions.text: Retired don is still in bed

parts.words: Retired don is still in bed
parts.note: looks like a pensioned academic lying in, but describes someone who has retired for the night and has not yet risen

explanation.definitionFit: Someone still in bed has not yet risen from sleep in the morning.

clue.text: Reading between the lines

parts.note: seems to be about inferring hidden meaning, but is a measurement taken of the distance between railway lines

explanation.definitionFit: The width separating the two rails of a track is measured by this standard.

clue.text: Fears loss of opener to slips

indicators.note: the opener of a word is its first letter, which is lost

parts.note: terrors are intense fears

explanation.surface: A batsman afraid of losing his opening partner to catches in the slips, the fielders behind the wicket.
explanation.walkthrough: Cricket misdirection: an opener is a batsman and the slips are close fielders, but here the opener is just the first letter, T.
explanation.definitionFit: Errors are mistakes, and slips is a common synonym for small mistakes.

clue.text: Down here fast changes are required

indicators.note: changes to the letters reorder them into a new word

explanation.surface: A remark that things must alter quickly in this downtrodden place.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Down' looks like a direction or mood, but it is the soft plumage of birds.
explanation.definitionFit: Down is the fine soft plumage of birds, made up of small fluffy feathers.
